This notion, however, requires that such laws of physics could exist within a multi-verse of other universes of conflicting nature. The problem with that being is that the universe is far too simple a place for such contrivances to reasonable to assume.

In all likely-hood, the laws and phenomena that make up all universes will be similar in nature, such that any interaction would be ruled by boundable criteria, much the way our own is.
